Opana Heaven
[Erowid Note: 
Because opiate use can lead to significant tolerance (requiring higher doses for the same effects), the dose used by a first time user is significantly smaller than that used by a regular user. It can be extremely dangerous to choose ones dose on the basis of the amount taken by someone else. Overdoses of opiates can be fatal.]
12/22/08-
I have been a chronic pain pt. For about 4 years now and have been prescribed many different opiates/opioid over time.I recently have been prescribed Avinza 180mg 1X daily along with OpanaIR/Oxymorphone 10MG Ir for break through pain.Usually I take my meds as directed but today I woke up feeling EXTRA crappy and had to go to a Dr's appointment.I began taking my meds on an empty stomach with my usual dose of 180mg of Avinza at approximately 0800 hrs.,after about 45 min.I still felt no relief so I decided to go with the breakthrough meds to give me an 'extra boost'. Usually I take 1 tab 4x daily but like I said I was feeling 'extra crappy'. I then took 3-10mg Opana at once but unlike most people that just swallow their meds I enjoy letting it dissolve sublingually and then washing the remainding paste down with a bit of grapefruit juice.
Within 15 min.I could already start feeling it comming on,that warm,comfortable,heavy eye feeling.I arrived at my Dr. Appointment where I sat and waited for what seemed to be an eternity.By this time I was in full blown oxymorphone/morphine heaven.I tried to avoid nodding by playing with my cell phone but no dice. The nodds were just coming every time I blinked. My whole body feeling nicely over relaxed,total body comfort,no pain,and not a care in the world.I figured let me go smoke a cigerette while I waited,I went outside and smoked the best tasting cigarette ever,came back in and started to wait again. All I want to do is close my eyes and float away. I went to the bathroom to check my pupils and they were about the size of a finely sharppened pencil point.I finally saw the Dr.,I don't think he noticed anything except me being extra talkative and then I was on my way home.
I got home CRAVING sweets and devowered some cupcakes which is the first and only thing I have eaten since writing this report(later I found out that'High Fat'foods potentiates the Opana).It has been 5 hrs. Since my initial dose and I can still feel the effects very much.I have nodded SEVEREL times while writing this report and still feel'GOOD'.
IMO Opana IR is by far  my favorite opiate.
Update-
Since the initial report I have turned to insulfating at least 2 of my 4 daily prescribed Opana.My tolerance has skyrocketed and I cannot achive the same effects unless I insulfate.Noted that
my tolerance built up VERY quickly,however I still LOVE this med.
